summary: Affine ADE Cartan matrices (Ã_2, D̃_4, Ẽ_8) all have det=0 and rank=size-1. Finite E_8 has det=1 (unimodular). The boundary det 1→0 at the affine extension marks the onset of infinite-dimensional Kac-Moody structure. z3 UNSAT proofs confirm these are necessary structural facts, not numerical accidents.
